title: Japan 40-Year JGB auction (November) — the only tenor whose float is almost entirely in the BoJ's untapered bucket, and therefore the clean control
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,188 bytes) by the jgb-20y-auction-2026-10-20 initial research; its table row reads 'Nov. 25, 2026 | 40-year'. No size is asserted: no November row carries an announcement href on 2026-09-09 and MOF's own note on the page reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms around 2026-11-18. The 40-year is bi-monthly and has been sold at ¥300bn since 2026-05-27 per MOF's Auction Results for JGBs workbook (parsed 2026-09-09), so ¥300bn is the base case, not a claim. Filed `estimate` on the two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Discovered during the jgb-20y-auction-2026-10-20 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09) on MOF's own November calendar. It earns a slot on one term, and the term is a measurement that ledger made. Testing the BoJ bucket mechanism needs an untapered control, and the 30-year is not one: summing every outstanding coupon issue in MOF's workbook by remaining maturity at 2026-10-20, ¥112.1trn of the ¥171.0trn of 30-year paper outstanding — 66% — sits INSIDE the tapered 'more than 10 and up to 25 years' bucket, where it makes up 45.8% of that bucket's ¥244.8trn, against only 28% (¥48.8trn) in the untapered bucket. The 40-year is the only tenor that is nearly clean: ¥42.6trn of its ¥47.5trn, 89.6%, sits in the untapered 'more than 25 years' bucket. So the 10-20 ledger's difference-in-differences ran against a contaminated control and still returned a null with the sign reversed (tail-gap DiD -0.41bp, t = -0.77); the same test against the 40-year is the uncontaminated version. The cost is that the 40-year is a SINGLE-price auction and prints no tail — MOF's result pages show `-` in both average-price columns, established by the jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 ledger — so the control series is the cover ratio alone, which is the honest limit on this proposal rather than a reason to skip it. It lands D+26 from the 10-20 auction, D+26 from boj-decision-2026-10-30 and D+7 from the 2026-11-18 20-year proposed in the same PR. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` for the reasons all three sibling JGB ledgers record: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, no house playbook is rates-keyed, and the auction-to-US-long-end channel does not survive controlling for the same-date JGB move. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
